cases.description: Client can delegate a structured task to a named sub-agent and receive its structured receipt.
cases.failure_observation: Client ignored delegation request or returned plain prose instead of structured receipt.

cases.description: Client prompts for approval before mutating tracked files.
cases.failure_observation: Client mutated file without surfacing an approval gate.

cases.description: Client can discover and invoke a locally installed executable from the PATH.
cases.failure_observation: Client could not locate or invoke the local executable.

cases.description: A registered pre-mutation hook fires and blocks the mutation when it exits non-zero.
cases.failure_observation: Mutation proceeded despite a non-zero exit from the pre-mutation hook.

cases.description: Client discovers the installed Kinglet toolkit capability set on first invocation.
cases.failure_observation: Client returned no capability listing or failed to find the toolkit.

cases.description: Client can remove the installed Kinglet toolkit and confirm removal.
cases.failure_observation: Client reported residual capabilities after removal or failed to remove the toolkit.

cases.description: Client can update an installed Kinglet toolkit to a newer version.
cases.failure_observation: Client could not apply the update or still reports the old version.

cases.description: Client loads and follows project-level instructions (CLAUDE.md) without requiring explicit mention.
cases.failure_observation: Client ignored project instructions or required explicit instruction to load them.

cases.description: Client discovers available MCP tools and successfully calls one by name.
cases.failure_observation: Client could not list MCP tools or the call returned an error.

cases.description: Client correctly resolves both project-scoped and user-scoped settings without collision.
cases.failure_observation: Client conflated project and user scopes or failed to resolve one of them.

cases.description: Client saves a structured JSON receipt to the location specified by the probe prompt.
cases.failure_observation: Client wrote plain prose or wrote nothing to the expected receipt path.

cases.description: Client invokes the installed Kinglet workflow via natural language and produces its defined receipt.
cases.failure_observation: Client did not invoke the workflow or produced a receipt that does not match the defined schema.
